That ratio is drift-biased (static FV vs a total-return path) and sensitive to a share-basis bug (OShares from a fin row about 63 days old vs the price on the as-of date, mismatched in 5.3% of rows at bonus/split events); excluding those rows gives 0.998. Confirm the diagnosis, but read the binary verdict as borderline, and fix the share-basis bug before phase 2."}
